required.description: Primary campaign objective (e.g., conversions, awareness, traffic)

required.name: target_audience
required.description: Target audience demographics, interests, and behaviors

required.name: product_description
required.description: Description of the product or service being advertised

optional.name: brand_voice
optional.description: Brand voice and tone guidelines for ad copy

optional.name: existing_ads
optional.description: Current ad creative for reference and iteration

optional.name: landing_page_urls
optional.description: Landing page URLs the ads will drive traffic to

optional.name: competitor_ads
optional.description: Competitor ad examples for differentiation analysis

optional.name: character_limits
optional.description: Platform-specific character limits for ad fields

optional.name: visual_guidelines
optional.description: Visual brand guidelines and image requirements

directories.description: All ad creative deliverables and testing plans

changelog.change: F1 convene-graded fix pass (SOUND-WITH-FIXES → applied 5 converged must-fixes). helpers/confirmed-terms-preflight.js: (1) replaced raw .includes() substring anchor matching with word-boundary matching (anchorRegex + escapeRegex) that also handles offer-symbol tokens ($500, 20%, $5,000) — closes the false-negative substring-collision bug (a dropped 'free' no longer satisfied by 'freelance'); (2) malformed/empty ledger now hard-fails (malformed-ledger / empty-ledger) instead of silently passing, waivable via --allow-empty-ledger; (3) a confirmed+must-appear term with no anchors now hard-fails (confirmed-term-unanchored) instead of only warning. guardrails.md Amendment B: narrowed the scope claim to the actually-wired executable path (prompt 03), marked prompt 02 note-only and prompt 05 not-yet-wired with TODOs; corrected the LIMITATIONS false-positive/false-negative labeling per the Gemini grade. Added fixture tests (helpers/__tests__/confirmed-terms-preflight.test.js, 12 cases, all passing). Helper stays advisory (verdict = evidence, not a hard gate).

F1 Confirmed-Terms Binding Preflight (guardrails.md Amendment B): provenance-tagged confirmed-terms ledger captured at intake (prompt 01) written to outputs/ad-creative/confirmed-terms-ledger.json; pre-authoring integrity + pending-fact gate and post-assembly omission diff in prompt 03; headline binding note in prompt 02; advisory helper helpers/confirmed-terms-preflight.js (confirmed-label integrity, omission diff, pending-load-bearing checks). Fixes the class of bug where copy was authored against a 'confirmed terms' doc that silently dropped a confirmed element and carried an uncited 'confirmed' fact. Advisory-default disposition (evidence, not a hard gate), consistent with Amendment A.

Human-voice overhaul (ad-creative-human-voice convene): exemplar-required brand voice w/ archetype fallback, pre-write message-architecture gate, one-message-per-ad + compliance carve-out, volume discipline, advisory severity-tiered copy-voice-lint, named read-aloud gate, local-register primer. Files: guardrails.md, prompts/01, assets/voice-archetypes.md, helpers/copy-voice-lint.js.
